name: Laravel Raw Query Builder SQL Injection
attack_scenario: Attacker sends age=0 UNION SELECT password FROM users; the interpolated whereRaw executes the union and leaks credentials.
negative_test_hint: submit age = "0 UNION SELECT password FROM users" and assert whereRaw binds it as a value or rejects it instead of interpolating it into the SQL

exemplar.explanation: whereRaw/DB::raw/orderByRaw/DB::select emit SQL verbatim; interpolating a $variable into the double-quoted string or concatenating with . injects unescaped user input straight into the query. Pass values as positional bindings (the ? + array form) and allowlist any column/direction names.
